Luego ambos se dirigen a un apartamento de los Monserrat donde Alicia le transfiere una suma considerable de dinero a Carlos y pacta un encuentro en un resort. Ricarda llega a su casa y se encuentra con su hija Giselle que no sabe nada de su estancia en prisión.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 128: Jesus terminal, el secreto de Rambo
programme.desc: Gabriel y Tomás le explican a Marisela que Jesús se encuentra en la etapa terminal de su enfermedad. En la Comisaría, Rambo confiesa que el día que murió la esposa del Dr. Núñez, él llevó a Malavé al edificio donde ella vivía. Mientras él lo esperaba se formó un zaperoco porque alguien se había lanzado del edificio. En ese momento bajó Malavé y ambos se fueron de allí. Inocencia va a ver a Abril para preguntarle si ha averiguado algo de su hijo y tras confirmar algunos detalles, ésta le asegura que ya sabe quien tiene a su bebé. Cachita conversa con Volcán acerca del bebé que compró Isadora y le pregunta cómo harán para que las pruebas de ADN indiquen que es hijo de Gabriel.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 171: Matilde y Gonzalo se separan
programme.desc: Pascuita y Monchito se enteran de que Matilde y Gonzalo se han separado. Gladis tendrá que decidir si lo celebra con Gabito o con Marco Aurelio

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 116: Revelaciones de Flavia y la operacion de Vicky
programme.desc: Flavia conversa con Betania siendo la responsable de confesarle a esta toda la verdad con relación a su madre quien tras ser víctima de las maldades de Berta y Armando enloqueció al verse separada de sus hijas. En la clínica Estrada efectúa la operación de Vicky al intentar salvar la vida de la joven muchacha. Daniela Michelle y Robert sintiéndose temerosos de encuentro entre Flavia y Betania despotrican en contra de su madre al creerla una traidora. Betania se horroriza al enterarse de los maltratos padecidos por Inés y su madre a manos de Berta y su propio tío Armando.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene vuelve a la empresa y se confronta nuevamente con Alejandra, quien no quiere que esta pise la empresa. Leonardo le pide a Irene que no lo vaya a visitar por unos días, pero se vuelve un problema secundario, cuando descubren que doña Jimena desapareció. Irene tiene una idea eficaz para encontrarla, y cuando esto ocurre, Leonardo va en busca de su mamá, quien fue lastimada por Maruja. Mientras tanto, en la empresa el ambiente está pesado. Leo se encuentra en graves problemas, llegando al punto de pedirle ayuda a Irene. Altair y Juan Pablo llegan al punto límite de su matrimonio, sincerando completamente los problemas de su relación teniendo de por medio a Carlos Ernesto.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol afronta la muerte de su madre junto a Alejandro. Ambos se cuestionan las últimas palabras de Raúla. Alejandro va a casa de Columba a avisar de la muerte. Maricielo es la ROKUra en enterarse y acude a acompañar a Sol. Sol le confía los dichos de Raúla y las extrañas circunstancias del accidente. Maricielo sospecha. El que también sospecha es José Domingo de Columba. A pesar de todo, ella concurre al apartamento de Eloy. Ahí charlan sobre la casa y él finalmente la besa.

Alejandra se está por ir a Europa, pero quiere cancelar el viaje.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad le cuenta a Jimena que Miguel es el padre de María Lucía. Jimena, a su vez, va a hablar con Carlos, que le revela un secreto sobre Miguel que empeora aún más la situación. Irene cree que está embarazada y va a la casa de Zulay a hacerse un test. Agustina amenaza con echar a todo el personal de la casa si nadie admite haber destruido el cuadro de su hermana.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca está viva y se encuentra con Adolfo para revelarle los planes a Alejandra. Ella le reprocha a Rodrigo por no haberle adelantado nada. Leonardo encuentra a su madre y a su hermano hablando en secreto, él insiste en que traman algo. Leonardo y Jimena discuten por un correo electrónico que ella hizo circular por la empresa revelando el pasado de Virginia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene está embarazada pero todavía no se lo ha contado a Leonardo. Carlos Ernesto le confiesa su amor a Virginia. Ella, sorprendida le agradece por su bondad y le dice que lo de ellos nunca va a poder ser. Oriana va a la casa de Alejandra y la atiende Rodrigo. Luego de algunas copas se acuestan y Oriana pasa la noche con él. Agustina está cada vez más loca.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le cuenta a Carlos Ernesto que Alejandra Altamirano le confirmó que Rebeca, su esposa, está viva. Irene le confirma a su amiga, Maribel, que está embarazada y que se lo va decir a Leonardo por la noche junto a sus hijos pero ella le dice que su esposo se irá de viaje. Virginia le dice a María Lucía que es su mamá y le cuenta las razones por las que no pudo hacerse cargo de ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo se reencuentra con Rebeca después de cinco años de separación. Ambos se encuentran muy conmocionados. El doctor le explica que cuando encontraron a Rebeca la pusieron bajo tratamiento, y que sus presupuestos no alcanzaban para averiguar sobre sus antecedentes, y un día le dieron medicación del laboratorio Ferrándiz, y ella recuperó absolutamente toda la memoria, y pudieron localizarlo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo descubre que para sacar a Rebeca de la isla tiene que pasar por inmigración y no tiene ninguna documentación. Mientras que los problemas retrasan a Leonardo cada vez más, Irene empieza a confundirse y a divagar el porqué del viaje inesperado de su esposo, angustiándose por no poder contarle que está esperando un hijo. Le pide ayuda a Maribel para que revisen los planes de vuelo del jet.

programme.title: Rastros do Além
programme.desc: Um cataclismo que rompe as barreiras entre o mundo e o próximo deixou "Remanescentes": fantasmas dos mortos que se tornam parte da vida cotidiana. Após 9 anos de convivência silenciosa com os vivos, um Remanescente ameaça uma adolescente, levando-a a uma missão que mudará o curso de sua vida para sempre.

programme.title: Insanidade
programme.desc: Uma mulher vai para o campo para passar um fim de semana tranquilo depois de perder o emprego e ter seu último relacionamento complicado chegando ao fim. Ela aluga uma casa de campo de um viúvo à moda antiga, que luta para esconder suas tendências homicidas.

programme.title: El Hechicero Del Diablo
programme.desc: En un pueblo del desierto de California, un cocinero de comida rápida con habilidades clarividentes se encuentra con un hombre misterioso que tiene un vínculo con fuerzas oscuras y amenazantes.

programme.title: O Sono da Morte
programme.desc: Jessie e Mark decidem adotar Cody, um menino que tem pavor de dormir. Inicialmente, eles acreditam que a fobia se origina do passado traumático do garoto. Mas logo descobrem a verdade: os sonhos de Cody são projetados na realidade, e muitas vezes o que se materializa são pesadelos horríveis e mortais.

programme.title: O Último Guarda-Costas
programme.desc: Após ser libertado da prisão, um criminoso do sul de Londres tenta esquecer seu passado e mudar de vida; ele então se torna o protetor de uma jovem atriz que enfrenta alguns problemas.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: A trama gira em torno do empreiteiro militar britânico Lex Walker, que é informado da morte de sua filha. Ao chegar em Los Angeles e descobrir que o corpo não é o dela, ele inicia uma investigação.

programme.title: La Hermana Buena
programme.desc: Fontayne es reclutada por Bernice (su vieja amiga distanciada y actual oficial de libertad condicional) junto con un policía deshonrado para buscar al hijo de Bernice, que desapareció en la frontera con México.

programme.title: Valan - Vale dos Anjos
programme.desc: O policial Peter investiga diversos desaparecimentos de jovens mulheres em um caso de rede de tráfico sexual. A cada menina que encontra, lembranças de sua irmã Juli, desaparecida há mais de vinte anos, vêm à tona. Após uma ligação, Peter é convocado a voltar a sua cidade natal na Transilvânia para investigar o caso do aparecimento de um corpo que, supostamente, pode ser de sua irmã. Agora, além de enfrentar os criminosos locais, Peter também terá que lutar contra seus próprios demônios do passado.

programme.title: Máxima Condena
programme.desc: Dos exagentes de operaciones encubiertas deben trasladar a dos convictas a una prisión. Durante el trayecto, unos desconocidos las atacan.

programme.title: Outra Vida
programme.desc: Uma cientista desenvolve uma droga revolucionária que induz realidades virtuais e expande a sensação de tempo. Quando o governo tenta assumir projeto, ela precisará decidir como usar sua poderosa criação.

programme.title: Risco Imediato
programme.desc: Um jovem casal de americanos que vive em Londres tem uma grande divida por justa causa. Uma manhã eles encontram que o inquilino do apartamento de baixo morre e deixa 200.000 em dinheiro. Tudo o que eles têm a fazer é pegar o dinheiro e todos os seus problemas seriam resolvidos. Então eles fazem, e desde ahi coisas muito ruins começam a acontecer para eles.

programme.title: Departamento Q: O Ausente
programme.desc: Dois jovens gêmeos são encontrados brutalmente assassinados em uma casa de verão. Uma série de pistas apontam na direção de estudantes de classe alta, mas o caso é encerrado quando um forasteiro se declara culpado. Vinte anos depois, o caso para na mesa do Departamento Q e Carl Morck logo percebe que algo está terrivelmente errado.

programme.desc: A história do escritor Amos Oz, nascido na Palestina e criado no período pós-guerra por um pai apaixonado por literatura e uma mãe polonesa que fugiu do antissemitismo. Amos Oz buscou um acordo de paz entre Israel e a Palestina.

programme.title: Terapia do Sexo
programme.desc: Uma comédia romântica que reúne três personagens distintos que aprendem a enfrentar um mundo desafiador e muitas vezes confuso enquanto lutam juntos contra um demônio em comum: o vício em sexo.

programme.desc: Depois de saber que ela foi incumbida de cuidar dos filhos de seu primo falecido, uma arquiteta fica dividida entre se concentrar em sua carreira e honrar o desejo de seu primo.

programme.desc: A médica em ascensão April tem a vida perfeita. Ela trabalha em um hospital prestigiado em Nova York e acabou de conhecer um veterinário bonito chamado Jesse. Entre eles, tudo vai muito bem. Eles combinam em tudo, exceto pelo fato de Jesse ser um pouco reservado quando o assunto é a família.

programme.title: O Amante da Rainha
programme.desc: Século XVIII. Caroline Mathilde é uma jovem britânica que se torna rainha da Dinamarca após se casar com o insano rei ChrisPan VII. Em viagem pela Europa, a saúde mental do monarca piora a cada dia e um acompanhamento médico torna-se necessário. O alemão Johann Struensee é escolhido e rapidamente conquista a confiança do rei, tornando-se seu confidente e principal conselheiro.

programme.desc: Francia, 1940. A la espera de noticias de su marido, un prisionero de guerra, la hermosa Lucile lleva una vida reprimida. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.title: Beauty and The Billionaire

programme.desc: With her indie video game business on the brink of bankruptcy, Kate (Mira Sorvino) throws a Hail Mary and puts Troy (Chris Carpenter), her teenage coding genius son, in charge of creating a video game to save the company. It’s a dream come true for Troy. But quite the opposite for the company’s disgruntled coders (Sean Astin, Mary Lynn Rajksub, Erik Griffin) and their rival CEO (Nelson Franklin).

programme.desc: Charlotte’s taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Eles podem ser chamados de Curtas, mas com eles a diversão não é nada curta. Veja as aventuras hilariantes deles e prepare-se para sorrir sem parar!

programme.title: Cante com o Bubu
programme.desc: A série musical da Coruja Pequena está repleta de músicas super divertidas de alta qualidade, escritas com cuidado, talento e originalidade. Cada uma delas vem em um estilo musical diferente para que as crianças possam aprender e se divertir cantando junto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.
